test_added: .sandcastle/android_evidence.test.mts: the required set derived from a branch (a public `void name(` added line becomes required; a private helper is not; a declared `## Android scenarios` method is required; a fenced example is not; the pinned smoke when no scenario changes; `no scenario names this change` for a changed surface), and the evidence judged (touches no Android code -> null, matching record -> null, no file, failed run, stale commit, dirty tree, short method list each refused with the defect named); .sandcastle/accept.test.mts: androidRefusal refuses a run with no evidence and passes on a record proving the branch; .sandcastle/boundary.test.mts: PROJECT.android facts are filled and the pinned smoke is a method the scenario file declares
concerns: The declared-section source is dead for core-only branches: android_evidence.mts:162 returns `not-android` (no requirement at all) as soon as no changed path is in `android.code`, before the issue's `## Android scenarios` is read. Probed with `requiredScenarios({diff:{touched:['src/core/engine/pencil.zig'],scenarios:''}, body:'## Android scenarios\n\n`freshAppWithAutoSave` ...'})` -> {"kind":"not-android"} and `checkAndroidEvidence` -> null, so a core change that declares its scenario is accepted with no device evidence — the one case android_evidence.mts:123 says the section exists for ("how a bridge or core change names the proof it needs").

The project seam gate lost coverage in this commit while the doc claims it gained some: boundary.test.mts:23-32 drops `archive.mts` from GENERIC_MODULES and never adds `android_evidence.mts`, yet docs/agents/sandcastle.md:170-171 lists both as generic modules that "never name this repository". Re-adding both to the list and running `node --test .sandcastle/boundary.test.mts` shows archive.mts clean and `android_evidence.mts names the Zig toolchain: "zig"` (its header comment, android_evidence.mts:3) — so the removal was not needed for archive and the module the commit message says "is scanned by the boundary test" is not scanned and would fail if it were.
